summary: Add nullable boolean column with default False, backfill existing rows to False, deploy new version with state_only migration, retire old version, then set column NOT NULL; DEFAULT False ensures old version concurrent inserts default to False instead of NULL.
write_consistency: During the overlap, old version inserts default to False via column DEFAULT False, new version writes False for updated rows; after backfill all 245 rows are False; NOT NULL constraint applied only after retire_old so old version no longer writes.
revision_notes: Changed expand_col stage: added DEFAULT FALSE to the new column definition so that the old version's concurrent inserts during deploy_new receive False instead of NULL, directly addressing the deploy_new.not_null.marketing_opt_in check failure where 2 NULL rows were observed. All other stages kept identical to the previous plan.

stages.description: Add nullable boolean column marketing_opt_in with default False to account_user.
sql: ALTER TABLE account_user ADD COLUMN marketing_opt_in BOOLEAN NULL DEFAULT FALSE;

stages.description: Set marketing_opt_in to False for all rows.
sql: UPDATE account_user SET marketing_opt_in = FALSE WHERE marketing_opt_in IS NULL;

stages.description: Retire the old version so it no longer serves traffic.
Make marketing_opt_in NOT NULL; safe as all rows backfilled and old version retired.
sql: ALTER TABLE account_user ALTER COLUMN marketing_opt_in SET NOT NULL;
